blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的任务,用自然语言描述一个面部图像的人类面部表情,它捕捉了超越传统情感类别或面部动作单位(AUs)的面部动作和情感状态的细微差别. 为了实现面部表情字幕模型,我们提出一个三阶段培训框架,利用合成图像文本对和BLIP-2预训技术来训练一个视觉到语言模型. 为了克服缺少用于面部表情描述的训练图像文本对的挑战,我们提出了一个策略,即使用GPT-3.5和关于情感类别或非盟的现有说明来合成和合并标题。 实验证明了我们的方法在生成描述面部动作和情绪细节的字幕方面的有效性,以及它们之间的推论关系,即使这些情绪在训练数据中没有出现. 同时还表明,从视觉到语言的任务提高了中间视觉功能在非盟检测和情感分类任务上的性能。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Facial expressions are a crucial form of nonverbal communication that convey a wide range of emotional states through subtle changes in facial muscle movements. The accurate perception and interpretation of facial expressions are critical for effective human-machine interactions. Existing works have focused on describing facial expressions by classifying them into pre-defined emotion categories (e.g., happiness, sadness, neutral, anger, disgust, surprise, fear) or detecting the appearance of facial action units (AUs) defined by the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) [ Ekman and Friesen(1978) ] .
However, these methods have limitations. Pre-defined emotion categories cannot capture all the nuances of facial expressions, while AUs do not convey the indicated affective status.
To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel facial expression captioning task that aims to describe facial actions and the corresponding emotional states of a facial image in natural language. Our approach provides a comprehensive and detailed understanding of facial expressions, which has the potential to improve accuracy and effectiveness in understanding and interacting with humans.
blocks.zh:
面部表情是非语言沟通的一种关键形式,通过面部肌肉运动的微妙变化来传达出广泛的情感状态. 对面部表情的准确感知和解释对于人与机器的有效互动至关重要. 现有作品主要通过将面部表情分类为预先定义的情感类别(如:幸福,悲伤,中性,愤怒,厌恶,出其不意,恐惧等)来描述面部表情,或者检测由Facial Action Coding System(FACS)[Ekman and Friesen(1978)]定义的面部动作单元(AUs)的外观.
然而,这些方法有局限性。 预定义的情感分类不能捕捉面部表情的所有细微差别,而AU则不传达所显示的情感状态.
为了克服这些限制,我们提出一个新的面部表情描述任务,旨在描述面部动作和自然语言中面部形象的相应情感状态. 我们的方法提供了对面部表情的全面而详细的理解,这有可能提高与人类理解和互动的准确性和有效性.

blocks.en:
It is non-trivial to accomplish facial expression captioning due to the lack of training image-text pairs that specifically describe nuances of facial expressions.
Although existing image captioning models such as CoCa [ Yu et al.(2022)Yu, Wang, Vasudevan, Yeung, Seyedhosseini, and Wu ] , BLIP [ Li et al.(2022)Li, Li, Xiong, and Hoi ] , and Flamingo [ Alayrac et al.(2022)Alayrac, Donahue, Luc, Miech, Barr, Hasson, Lenc, Mensch, Millican, Reynolds, et al. ] demonstrate remarkable performance in describing the contents of an image, they fall short in describing the nuances of facial expressions. This limitation arises from the fact that the training image-text pairs typically do not provide the level of detail required to train a facial expression captioner.
However, collecting such image-text pairs presents a significant challenge. Annotators must possess exceptional writing skills and the ability to recognize and describe the full range of facial expressions. Additionally, even with expert annotators, the process of annotation is time-consuming.
blocks.zh:
由于缺乏专门描述面部表情细微差别的训练图像文本配对,完成面部表情字幕是非三角性的.
虽然现有的图像字幕模型有CoCa[Yu等人(2022年)Yu,Wang,Vasudevan,Yeung,Seyedhosseini和Wu],BLIP[Li等人(2022年)Li, Li, Xiong, and Hoi],和Flamingo [Alayrac等 (2022) Alayrac, Donahue, Luc, Miech, Barr, Hasson, Lenc, Mensch, Millican, Reynolds等]在描述一幅图像的内容时表现出了出众的性能,他们未能描述面部表情的细微差别. 这一限制源于这样一个事实,即培训图像文本对通常不能提供培训面部表情字幕所需的详细程度。
然而,收集这种图像文本对是一个重大挑战。 注释者必须具备出众的写作技能并有能力识别和描述面部表情的全部范围. 此外,即使有专家的注释者,注释的过程也是费时的。

blocks.en:
To overcome the scarcity of training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a three-stage framework that leverages synthetic image-text pairs synthesized using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on emotion categories and AUs.
As data labeled with both emotion categories and AUs are rarely available, our proposed framework combines captions generated by the emotion-specific captioner (Emot-BLIP) and the AU-specific captioner (AU-BLIP) to train the final captioner (Exp-BLIP) using the combined captions and their corresponding images.
Our contributions are summarised as follows: (1) We propose facial expression captioning, a new task to describe nuances of facial expressions and infer the corresponding emotions in words. Compared with conventional emotion classification and AU detection tasks, facial expression captioning interprets facial expressions in a more detailed and comprehensive way. (2) To train the captioner for facial expression captioning, we propose a three-stage framework that utilizes synthetic image-text pairs. This approach enables the training even when the training data that describe both facial actions and emotions are not available. (3) Extensive experiments demonstrate the powerful ability of the trained facial expression captioner and the intermediate visual representation.
Our method produces captions that describe details of the facial actions and emotions, even if the emotions are not in the training data.
Experiments also demonstrate that vision-to-language task improves the representation ability of the intermediate visual features on AU detection and emotion classification tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关作品

blocks.en:
Facial expression description method: The current approaches to describing facial expressions primarily involve emotion classification [ Wang et al.(2020)Wang, Peng, Yang, Lu, and Qiao , Zhang et al.(2022c)Zhang, Wang, Ling, and Deng , Zeng et al.(2022)Zeng, Lin, Yan, Liu, Wang, and Tang , Lukov et al.(2022)Lukov, Zhao, Lee, and Lim ] and AU detection [ Shao et al.(2021)Shao, Liu, Cai, and Ma , Jacob and Stenger(2021) , Wang et al.(2022)Wang, Qi, Cheng, and Suzuki , Luo et al.(2022)Luo, Song, Xie, Shen, and Gunes ] tasks. Emotion classification typically consists of categorizing emotions into eight basic categories: neutral, anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and contempt [ Matsumoto(1992) ] . To address the limitations of describing facial expressions with single emotions, compound emotions [ Du et al.(2014)Du, Tao, and Martinez ] was proposed by combining several basic emotions. To overcome the shortcomings of archetypal expression descriptions, Ekman et al. [ Ekman and Friesen(1978) ] developed the facial action coding system (FACS) based on facial anatomy, which defines 44 AUs by focusing on different facial parts.
However, it is important to note that both emotions and AUs alone cannot fully capture the complexity of facial status. Recently, Nezami et al. [ Nezami et al.(2020)Nezami, Dras, Wan, and Paris ] have proposed a novel image captioning model that utilized facial expression features to generate image captions. Their work stated that the improvement in caption quality appeared to come not from the addition of adjectives linked to emotional aspects of the images, but from more variety in the actions described in the captions. Furthermore, Bryson [ Lingenfelter(2021) ] introduced a meticulous approach to generating weak prominent feature labels using semantic segmentation, demonstrating how these labels could enhance attribute-based face descriptions.

blocks.en: 3 Facial Expression Captioning
blocks.zh: 3 面相表达式说明

blocks.en:
This paper aims to develop an image captioner that describes the nuances of facial actions and the corresponding emotional states of a facial image in natural language.
To achieve this goal, we propose a three-stage framework that leverages synthetic image-text pairs.
Figure 1 illustrates the proposed framework.
In the first step, we synthesize the training image-text pairs using the prevalent large language model (e.g., GPT-3.5) or a rule-based text generator.
In the second step, we train two separate captioners, AU-BLIP and Emot-BLIP, using synthetic pairs that describe facial expressions’ specific aspects, including AUs and emotions.
We do not directly train an image captioner that simultaneously describes both facial actions and emotions, as it is a challenge to derive training texts that correctly describe both two aspects due to few datasets being annotated with both emotions and AUs.
In the third step, we combine the outputs of AU-BLIP and Emot-BLIP to synthesize descriptions for each image. With the combined captions, we train the final captioner (Exp-BLIP) to describe both aspects of facial expressions.
Below, we present details of the three steps.
blocks.zh:
本文旨在开发一个图像字幕器来描述面部动作的细微差别和面部图像在自然语言中相应的情感状态.
为了实现这一目标,我们提出了一个利用合成图像文本对的三阶段框架。
图1说明了拟议框架。
在第一步,我们用流行的大语言模型(如:GPT-3.5)或基于规则的文本生成器来合成训练成像-文本对.
第二步,我们训练两个独立的字幕,AU-BLIP和Emot-BLIP,使用合成对来描述面部表情的具体方面,包括AU和情感.
我们并不直接训练一个同时描述面部动作和情绪的图像字幕员,因为由于很少用情感和AU来注释数据集,因此很难获得正确描述这两个方面的训练文本。
在第三步,我们把AU-BLIP和Emot-BLIP的产出结合起来,以综合每个图像的描述. 使用组合字幕,我们训练出最终字幕(Exp-BLIP)来描述面部表情的两个方面.
下面,我们介绍三个步骤的细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthesis of the training image-text pairs
blocks.zh: 3.1 培训图像文本组合

blocks.en:
To train the image captioners, AU-BLIP and Emot-BLIP that are respectively specialized for AUs and Emotions, we constitute the training image-text pairs by synthesizing descriptive texts based on annotations of AUs and emotion categories for the corresponding facial images.
The texts are synthesized in two ways: the rule-based text generator, and the GPT-based generator with one-shot prompt.
Examples of the two types of generators are shown in Figure 2 . We use both generators to ensure diverse descriptions of facial actions. For synthesizing descriptions of emotions, we only use the rule-based text generator.
blocks.zh:
为了培训图像字幕, AU-BLIP 和 Emot-BLIP 分别是专为 AU 和 Emots 设计的, 我们通过根据 AU 的 说明和情感 分类来合成描述性文本来构成培训图像文本对 。
文本的合成有两种方式:基于规则的文本生成器,和基于一发快取的基于GPT的生成器.
这两类发电机的例子见图2。 我们用两种发电机来保证面部动作的描述多种多样. 为了合成对情绪的描述,我们只使用基于规则的文本生成器.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Inputs and outputs examples of the rule-based text generators for AUs and emotions(Left) and those of the GPT-3.5 based generator with one-shot prompt(Right) for AUs.
blocks.zh: 图2:基于规则的文本生成器的输入和输出实例,用于AU和情感(Left),以及基于GPT-3.5的生成器的输入和输出实例,用于AU的一发快取(Right).

blocks.en:
Rule-based labeling for AU captions: To synthesize concise and complete descriptions of facial actions, we leverage the annotations of AUs because most facial muscle movements are depicted as AUs by FACS [ Ekman and Friesen(1978) ] .
As shown in Fig. 2 , given a facial image and its label that indicates the appearance of each AU, we combine the brief descriptions of the appearing AU and make a sentence in the form of ”It is a people who ¡action in appearing AUs¿”.
The brief descriptions of each AU are listed in the supplemental materials. If no AUs are labeled as appearing in a face, we do not synthesize rule-based AU descriptions for the image.
blocks.zh:
基于规则的非盟标题标签 : 为了综合对面部动作的简明完整描述,我们利用了AU的注释,因为大多数面部肌肉运动被FACS描绘为AU [Ekman and Friesen (1978)].
如图2所显示的,鉴于一个面部形象及其标签显示每个非盟的外表,我们合并了对出现的非盟的简短描述,并用“是一个人民采取行动,让非盟出现”的形式作出句子。
每个非盟的简要说明列于补充材料中。 如果没有任何非盟被标注为出现在一面,我们不会综合基于规则的非盟对图像的描述.

blocks.en:
GPT-based labeling for AU captions: To ensure diverse training texts, we also utilize GPT-3.5 to synthesize descriptions for facial actions.
However, the outputs of GPT-3.5 are uncontrolled and it might include the re-introduction of AUs, the induction of different emotions, and other irrelevant contents.
To achieve a clear and concise description, we design a one-shot prompting strategy that requires GPT-3.5 to act as an AU expert and provides it with an example.
Fig. 2 shows an example. We first claim the list of AUs’ definitions and then state the requirement through a Question-Answer example.
We explicitly add two restrictions to regulate GPT-3.5’s outputs, prohibiting the induction of emotion and the repetition of the word ”AU” in the reply.
Then, we throw out the question that asks GPT-3.5 to describe the face with the annotated AUs. If no AUs are labeled, we use a predetermined description to avoid inaccurate outputs from GPT-3.5, which is listed in the supplemental material.
blocks.zh:
基于 GPT 的 AU 字幕标签 : 为了确保各种培训文本,我们还利用GPT-3.5综合面部动作描述.
然而,GPT-3.5的产出不受控制,可能包括重新引入非盟、诱发不同的情绪以及其他无关的内容。
为了作出清楚而简洁的描述,我们设计出一发催化战略,要求GPT-3.5担任非盟专家,并以此为例。
图2显示了一个例子。 我们首先提出非盟定义清单,然后通过“问答”的例子说明这一要求。
我们明确增加了两项限制,以规范GPT-3.5的产出,禁止在答复中诱发情绪并重复“AU”一词。
然后,我们抛出一个问题,要求GPT-3.5用附加说明的非盟来描述面相. 如果不给非盟贴上标签,我们就使用预先确定的说明来避免GPT-3.5的不准确输出,该产出列于补充材料中。

blocks.en:
Rule-based labeling for emotion captions: To keep the correct description of emotions, we synthesize the descriptions of emotions by simply generating a sentence in the form of ”The face shows ¡emotion category¿” according to the manual annotations in the existing datasets.
If the images are labeled with more than one emotion category, e.g., compound emotions [ Li et al.(2017)Li, Deng, and Du ] or multi-label emotion category [ Lu et al.(2019)Lu, Zeng, Shan, and Chen ] , we merge the involved emotion labels.
blocks.zh:
基于规则的情感标题标签: 为了保持对情绪的正确描述,我们综合了对情绪的描述,只是根据现有数据集的手动说明,以"面部显示"("emotion speciale")的形式产生句子.
如果图像被贴上不止一个情感类的标签,例如复合情感[李等 (2017)Li, Deng, and Du] 或多标签情感类 [吕等 (2019)Lu, Zeng,,,,,,, 珊,和陈),我们合并了相关的情感标签.

blocks.en: 3.2 Training of AU-specific and emotion-specific image captioners
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训非盟特有的和情感特有的图像字幕

blocks.en:
We use the synthetic pairs in Sec. 3.1 to train two image captioners:
One describes facial actions (AU-BLIP),
and the other describes emotions (Emot-BLIP).
Both two captions are trained following the framework in BLIP-2 [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] .
In addition, other vision-to-language models can also be adopted in our three-stage facial expression captioning framework.
blocks.zh:
我们用第3.1节的合成配对来训练两个图像字幕:
一描述了面部动作(AU-BLIP),
而其他则描述了情感(Emot-BLIP).
两个标题都按照BLIP-2的框架加以培训[Li等(2023b)Li, 李,萨瓦雷塞,和合
此外,还可以在我们三阶段面部表情字幕框架中采用其他视觉到语言模型.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Two-step training procedure of BLIP-2 [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] . The 1 st {}^{\text{st}} step ( Left ): BLIP-2 enforces the queries to extract the visual representation most relevant to the text. The 2 nd {}^{\text{nd}} step( Right ): BLIP-2 bootstraps from frozen LLMs to conduct vision-to-language generative training.
blocks.zh: 图3:BLIP-2的分两步培训程序[李等人(2023b)Li, 李,萨瓦雷塞,和合 1st QQtext{st}} 步骤 (左):BLIP-2执行查询以提取与文本最相關的视觉表现. 2nd {text{nd}步骤 (右):BLIP-2 从冷冻的LLMS来进行视觉到语言的基因训练.

blocks.en:
Revisiting BLIP-2: Fig. 3 illustrates the architecture of BLIP-2 and its two-step training procedure.
As can be seen in Fig. 3 (Right), BLIP-2 takes an image as input, and then extracts the visual features from a pre-trained image encoder.
The visual features are then passed through a Q-Former and a pre-trained large language model(LLM). Finally, BLIP-2 outputs a description of the input image.
Q-Former is a trainable module that connects the image encoder and LLM. The detailed structure of Q-Former is illustrated in Fig. 3 (Left).
It is trained in two steps.
In the first step, as shown in Fig. 3 (Left), to guide the learned queries to aggregate the vision-language representation from the image encoder and training texts, BLIP-2 freezes the image encoder and optimizes Q-Former by minimizing the Image-Text Contrastive Learning (ITC) loss, Image-grounded Text Generation (ITG) loss and Image-Text Matching (ITM) loss.
The self-attention layers for the queries and the texts share the same parameters.
As BLIP-2 [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] does, attention masking is applied to prevent information leakage.
In the second step, to harvest the LLM’s generative language capability and adjust the image encoder to extract features that are more related to the image captioning task, BLIP-2 connects Q-Former to a frozen LLM, as shown in Fig. 3 (Left), and jointly update the parameters of Q-Former and the image encoder by
minimizing the discrepancy between the LLM-generated caption and the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
修订BLIP-2:图3说明了BLIP-2的结构及其分两步的培训程序.
如Fig. 3(Right)所见,BLIP-2取出一个图像作为输入,再从预先训练的图像编码器中取出视觉特征.
视觉特征随后通过Q-Former和被预训的大语言模型(LLM)来传递. 最后,BLIP-2给出了输入图像的描述.
Q-Former是连接图像编码器和LLM的可列车模块. Q-Former的详细结构如图3 (Left)所示.
它分两步训练。
如图3 (Left)所显示,为引导所学到的查询将图像编码器和培训文本中的视觉语言表现汇总起来,BLIP-2冻结了图像编码器并优化了Q-Former,将图像-文本对比学习(ITC)损失最小化,图像定位文本生成(ITG)损失和图像-文本匹配(ITM)损失.
查询和文本的自留层具有相同的参数。
作为BLIP-2[李等 (2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi]确实,注意口罩是用来防止信息泄露的.
第二步,为收获LLM的基因语言能力并调整图像编码器以提取出与图像标题任务更相干的特点,BLIP-2将Q-Former连接到一个被冻结的LLM,如图3(Left)所示,并联合更新了Q-Former和图像编码器的参数由
最小化 LLM 生成的字幕和地面真伪之间的差异。

blocks.en: Pre-trained image encoder and LLM: For the image encoder, we utilize ViT-G/14 from EVA-CLIP [ Fang et al.(2023)Fang, Wang, Xie, Sun, Wu, Wang, Huang, Wang, and Cao ] and a ViT-Base trained on AffectNet [ Mollahosseini et al.(2017)Mollahosseini, Hasani, and Mahoor ] dataset under the training framework of MAE [ He et al.(2022)He, Chen, Xie, Li, Dollár, and Girshick ] . Consistent with BLIP-2, we choose the unsupervised-trained OPT model family [ Zhang et al.(2022b)Zhang, Roller, Goyal, Artetxe, Chen, Chen, Dewan, Diab, Li, Lin, et al. ] as our language model. Model details are listed in supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 预训图像编码器和 LLM : 对于图像编码器,我们使用来自EVA-CLIP的VIT-G/14[Fang等 (2023)Fang, 王爷 谢, 孙 Wu, Wang, Huang, Wang, and Cao)和一个ViT-Base在MAE的训练框架下接受了关于AffectNet的培训[Mollahosseini等 (2017) Mollahosseini, Hasani, and Mahoor]的数据集[He等 (2022)He, Chen, Xie,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,, ,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,, 李,多拉尔,和吉尔希克]. 与BLIP-2一致,我们选择未经监督训练的北平模式家族[张等(2022b)张等,罗勒,高雅尔,阿特克塞,陈等,陈等,德旺,迪亚布,李等,林等]作为我们的语言模式. 模型细节列于补充材料.

blocks.zh: 图4:基于GPT-3.5的生成器的输入和输出示例,并带有零发快取来发动非盟和情感字幕. 由引信字幕描述的图像位于右边.

blocks.en: 3.3 Exp-BLIP with fused captions
blocks.zh: 3.3 带有引信标题的BLIP

blocks.en:
We train the final facial expression captioner (Exp-BLIP) with the synthesized descriptions by GPT-3.5 and AU-BLIP/Emot-BLIP.
Fig. 1 (Right) shows how we train Exp-BLIP.
To assign each training image a description of both AU and emotion, we use AU-BLIP/Emot-BLIP to generate a pseudo-caption if it lacks the original annotation on AU/Emotion.
Then, we utilize GPT-3.5 to fuse the two captions with zero-shot prompting, leveraging the powerful inferring ability of GPT-3.5.
Fig. 4 shows an example of zero-shot prompting in fusing captions.
With the fused captions, we train Exp-BLIP following the architecture and training procedure of BLIP-2 [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们用GPT-3.5和AU-BLIP/Emot-BLIP的合成描述来训练最终面部表情字幕(Exp-BLIP).
图1(右)显示我们如何训练Ex-BLIP.
要给每个训练图像都描述非盟和情感,我们使用AU-BLIP/Emot-BLIP来生成一个伪封装,如果它缺乏非盟/Emotion的原始注释.
然后,我们利用GPT-3.5将两个标题以零射出导火线来引信,利用了GPT-3.5强大的推断能力.
图4显示一个零发射在引信标题中提示的例子。
有了装有引信的标题,我们按照BLIP-2的架构和培训程序培训Ex-BLIP[Li等(2023b)Li, (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). Li, Savarese, and Hoi] in Sec. 3.1.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the performance of AU-BLIP, Emot-BLIP, and Exp-BLIP from two perspectives: the quality of generated captions, and the ability of visual representation.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个角度评价AU-BLIP、Emot-BLIP和Ex-BLIP的性能:生成字幕的质量以及视觉表现的能力。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Training data: We used nearly 372k training image-text pairs in total.
72k of the training data are derived from AU datasets BP4D [ Zhang et al.(2013)Zhang, Yin, Cohn, Canavan, Reale, Horowitz, and Liu ] , DISFA [ Mavadati et al.(2013)Mavadati, Mahoor, Bartlett, Trinh, and Cohn ] , GFT [ Girard et al.(2017)Girard, Chu, Jeni, and Cohn ] , RAF-AU [ Yan et al.(2020)Yan, Li, Que, Pei, and Deng ] and EmotioNet [ Fabian Benitez-Quiroz et al.(2016)Fabian Benitez-Quiroz, Srinivasan, and Martinez ] using the rule-based text generator and GPT-based generator in Sec. 3.1 . Texts from the two generators were both used to train AU-BLIP. Only the GPT-3.5 generated ones were used to synthesize training pairs for Exp-BLIP.
Considering the high cost of using GPT-3.5 API 1 1 1 https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/gpt/chat-completions-api and the significant similarity among the consecutive frames in video-based AU datasets, we first select one sample from every ten frames. Then, we selected the frames which had different AU labels compared with the previous frame to fully utilize the datasets. This selection was conducted in training sets of video-based AU datasets (BP4D, DISFA, and GFT) and test set of GFT.
300k of the training data are derived from AffectNet, RAF-DB [ Li et al.(2017)Li, Deng, and Du ] and FaceME [ Lu et al.(2019)Lu, Zeng, Shan, and Chen ] .
All of the datasets except FaceME are split into training and test parts without overlapped subjects.
Tab. 1 shows the statistics of training and test data.
blocks.zh:
培训数据: 我们总共使用了近372克的训练图像文本对.
72克培训数据取自非盟数据集 BP4D [张等 (2013年) 张等 (2013年) 张等 (2018年) 殷等 (2018年) 科恩 (2018年) Canavan, Reale, Horowitz, and Liu], DISFA [马瓦达提等 (2013年) 马瓦达提,马霍尔,巴特利特,特林克和科恩], GFT [吉拉德等 (2017年) Girard等 (2017年) Girard, Chu, Jeni, and Cohn], RAF-AU [Yan等 (2020年) Yan, Li, Que, Pei, and Deng] 和 EmotioNet [Fabian Benitez-Quiroz等 (2016年) Fabian Benitez-Quiroz, Srinivasan, and Martinez] 使用基于规则的文本生成器和基于 GPT的生成器在 Sec. 3.1 (中文(简体) ). 两台发电机的文本都用于培训AU-BLIP。 只有GPT-3.5生成的一款用于为Exp-BLIP合成培训对.
考虑到使用GPT-3.5 API 1 1 https://plateform.openai.com/docs/guides/gpt/chat-completes-api的成本高昂,以及视频制成的非盟数据集中连续帧之间有显著的相似性,我们首先从每10个帧中选择一个样本. 然后,我们选择了与前一个框架相比具有不同非盟标签的框架来充分利用数据集。 这一选择是在以视频为基础的非洲联盟数据集(BP4D、DISFA和GFT)和GFT测试集的培训中进行的。
300克的培训数据来自AffectNet、RAF-DB[Li等(2017)Li、Deng和Du]和FaceME[Lu等(2019)Lu、Zeng, 山,和陈].
除FaceME外,所有数据集均被分解为训练和测试部分,没有重叠的科目.
标签1显示了培训和测试数据的统计数据。

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol for image captioning: We evaluated our image captioning models in two ways: (1) computing metrics for AU captioning, and (2) conducting manual evaluation to assess the completeness and correctness of facial expression captioning.
The former was conducted on both in-the-lab data (test set of GFT) and in-the-wild data (test set of RAF-AU).
we chose Meteor [ Banerjee and Lavie(2005) ] , Rouge [ Lin(2004) ] and Ada-similarity (Ada-sim) between the generated captions and the ground truths as our metrics.
Ada-similarity calculated the cosine similarity of two features extracted from text-embedding-ada-002 2 2 2 https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/embeddings/what-are-embeddings .
Since each sample has multiple ground truths (synthesized by GPT-3.5 and the rule-based generator), we computed the metrics between the predicted caption and each ground truth, and then we chose the highest score.
The latter was conducted on 505 samples randomly chosen from all the test data in Tab. 1 .
Then, we invited 9 human labelers to rate the correctness of each predicted caption from 1 to 10 and to choose the most/least complete one from the three predictions.
blocks.zh:
图像标题的评价协议 : 我们以两种方式评价了我们的图像字幕模型:(1) 计算非盟字幕的衡量标准;(2) 进行人工评估,以评估面部表情字幕的完整性和正确性。
前者既使用实验室内数据(测试集GFT),又使用网络内数据(测试集RAF-AU)。
我们选择了Meteor [Banerjee and Lavie(2005年)],Ruge [Lin(2004年)]和Ada-similary(Ada-sim)作为我们的衡量标准。
Ada-simility计算出从文本嵌入-ada-002 2 2 https://plateform.openai.com/docs/guides/embeddings/What-are-embeddings中取出的两个特征的同位素相似性 。 。 。 。
由于每个样本有多个地面真理(由GPT-3.5和基于规则的生成器合成),我们计算了预测标题和每个地面真理之间的度量,然后我们选择了最高分.
后者是根据从Tab的所有测试数据中随机选择的505个样本进行的。 1 (英语).
然后,我们请了9个人类标签 将每个预言标题的正确性从 1 到 10 , 从3 个预测中选择一个最/最完整。

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol for visual presentation: We evaluated the visual representations from the image encoder and Q-Former by investigating their performance in AU detection and emotion classification tasks using a linear probe or a fine-tuning strategy.
We added a fully connected layer after the representation as the classifier. The AU classifier was trained on full BP4D and RAF-AU training set without sampling, while the emotion classifier was trained on AffectNet. In the linear probe, the image encoder and Q-Former were frozen.
In the fine-tuning strategy, the parameters of the image encoder and Q-Former were updated.
F1 score and classification accuracy were used to measure the performance of AU detection and emotion classification, respectively.
To compare with state-of-the-art (SOTA) method in RAF-AU, we selected the same AUs of AU-CNN [ Yan et al.(2020)Yan, Li, Que, Pei, and Deng ] for training.
blocks.zh:
视觉展示的评价协议: 我们通过使用线性探测器或微调策略来调查其在非盟检测和情感分类任务中的表现,评价了图像编码器和Q-Former的视觉表现.
我们在代表作为分类器后增加了一个完全连接的层. 非盟分类员接受了关于BP4D和RAF-AU全集培训的培训,但没有取样,而情感分类员则接受了关于AffectNet的培训。 在线性探测器中,图像编码器和Q-Former被冻结.
在微调策略中,更新了图像编码器和Q-Former的参数.
F1分和分类精度分别用于测量非盟检测和情感分类的性能.
与RAF-AU中最先进的(SOTA)方法相提并论,我们选择了AU-CNN[Yan等2020年)Yan,Li,Que,Pei,和Deng]的同一批AU-CNN的AU进行训练.

blocks.en: Implementation: During the training of AU-BLIP, Emot-BLIP, and Exp-BLIP, we used a batch size of 28 for the first step and 32 for the second step. We used the AdamW [ Loshchilov and Hutter(2019) ] optimizer and a weight decay of 0.05. A cosine learning rate decay with a peak learning rate of 1e-4 and a linear warm-up of 2k steps was adopted. The minimum learning rate in the second step was 5e-5. The input images were of size 224×224, augmented with random resized cropping and horizontal flipping. All the experiments run on 4 Nvidia A100 (40G).
blocks.zh: 执行: 在AU-BLIP, Emot-BLIP,和Ex-BLIP的训练期间,我们用批量尺寸的28为第一步,32为第二步. 我们使用了 AdamW [Lohchilov and Hutter(2019)] 优化器和 0.05 的重量衰减。 采用了余弦学习速率衰减,峰值学习速率为1e-4,线性取暖2k步. 第二步的最低学习率为5e-5. 输入图像尺寸为224x224,通过随机调整尺寸和横向翻转而得到扩充。 所有实验都运行在4 Nvidia A100(40G)上.

blocks.en: 4.2 Experiment results and analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验结果和分析

blocks.en:
Evaluation on image captioning: Table 2 reports the metrics on AU captioning using the original BLIP-2 [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] , AU-BLIP, Exp-BLIP, Mix-BLIP, Cat-BLIP with different versions of image encoder and LLMs.
Mix-BLIP and Cat-BLIP adopt different approaches to fuse AU caption and emotion caption(Sec. 4.3 ).
BLIP-2 is the model provided by [ Li et al.(2023b)Li, Li, Savarese, and Hoi ] that was trained on 129M images.
BLIP-2 COCO {}^{\text{COCO}} is the fine-tuned BLIP-2 on COCO [ Lin et al.(2014)Lin, Maire, Belongie, Hays, Perona, Ramanan, Dollár, and Zitnick ] for general image captioning.
As shown in Table 2 , our models trained on AU-specific data achieve consistently larger values than the two models trained for general image captioning, because the general image captioner describes limited information on facial expressions, as shown in Fig. 5 .
It indicates the necessity to train a task-specific vision-to-language model for describing facial expressions even though the general captioning model has shown powerful ability.
blocks.zh:

Strategies for combining AU and emotion captions: Table 5 displays the assessments of the correctness and completeness of captions generated by three models, which fuse AU and emotion captions using different strategies.
Mix-BLIP trains the facial expression captioner using the mixed data that with only AU captions or emotion captions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce facial expression captioning as a novel task that aims to capture the nuanced facial actions and emotional states of a given facial image in natural language. To tackle this task, we propose a three-stage training framework that employs synthetic image-text pairs to train a facial expression captioner called Exp-BLIP. The experimental results showcase the powerful ability of Exp-BLIP and the intermediate visual representation. Nonetheless, Exp-BLIP suffers from certain limitations inherited from the pre-trained large models, such as generating repeated, syntax errors, or harmful content, which are inevitable in a frozen language model.
Exp-BLIP can be further enhanced by adopting more powerful LLMs and image encoders, and leveraging more data from other related tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了面部表情字幕 作为一项新颖的任务, 旨在捕捉 微小的面部动作 和情感状态 特定面部形象 在自然语言。 为了完成这项任务,我们提出一个三阶段培训框架,利用合成图像文本对来训练一个面部表情字幕器,叫Ex-BLIP. 实验结果展示了Exp-BLIP和中间视觉表现的强大能力. 尽管如此,Exp-BLIP还是受到一些从预先训练的大型模型中继承下来的局限性,例如产生重复的,语法错误,或者有害的内容,在被冻结的语言模型中是不可避免的.
Exp-BLIP可以通过采用更强大的LLMs和图像编码器,并借助从其他相关任务中获得的更多数据而得到进一步的增强.

blocks.en: The training AU captions are synthesized in two ways: the rule-based text generator, and the GPT-based generator with one-shot prompt. For the rule-based AU captions labeling, the brief descriptions of each AU are listed in Table S1 verb form. In order to ensure the syntactic correctness of synthesized captions, we appended s/es to the descriptions when merging them to the captions. If no AUs were labeled, we did not synthesize rule-based AU descriptions for the image. For GPT-based AU captions synthesizing, we first listed all 27 Action Units defined by the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), which were listed in Table S1 noun form. Consequently, we conducted one-shot prompting to achieve GPT-based AU captions. If no AUs were labeled, we used a predetermined GPT-synthesized description in Sec. S1.2 to avoid inaccurate outputs from GPT-3.5.
blocks.zh: 培训 AU 字幕以两种方式合成:基于规则的文本生成器和基于 GPT 的生成器带有一发快取. 对于基于规则的非盟标题标签,每个非盟的简要说明在表S1动词表中列出. 为了确保合成标题的合成正确性,我们在将它们合并到标题时将 s/es 附加在说明后. 如果不给非盟贴上标签,我们没有综合该图像的基于规则的非盟描述。 对于基于 GPT 的 AU 字幕合成,我们首先列出由 Facial 动作编码系统(FACS)定义的所有27个动作单位,这些单位列在表S1名词表. 因此,我们进行了一发催促,以实现基于GPT的非盟字幕。 如果没有给AU贴上标签,我们在Sec.S1.2中使用了预先确定的GPT合成描述来避免出自GPT-3.5的不准确输出.

blocks.en: S1.2 Predetermined description of no AUs
blocks.zh: S1.2 预先确定的无非盟说明

blocks.en: Due to the diversity of GPT-3.5’s output and the high similarity of faces with no AUs labeled, we used a predetermined description which we selected from several outputs of GPT-3.5 for describing faces with no AUs. By conducting this strategy, we reduced the risk for GPT-3.5 to synthesize extra inaccurate descriptions for faces with no AUs. The predetermined description of no AUs is: The eyes may be open and looking straight ahead, with the mouth closed or slightly open in a relaxed position. The forehead may be relatively smooth with minimal wrinkles or creases. The eyebrows may be in a natural position, not raised or furrowed.
blocks.zh: 由于GPT-3.5输出的多样性以及没有AU标签的面相高度相似,我们使用了一种预先确定的说明,我们从GPT-3.5的若干出品中选择了这个描述面相,没有AU标签。 通过实施这一策略,我们降低了GPT-3.5对没有非盟的面孔进行超准确描述的风险. 预先确定的无AU的描述是: 眼睛可能开着并直视前方,嘴会闭上或稍微开开出放松的姿势. 额头可能相对平滑并有最小的皱纹或折痕. 眉毛可能处于自然位置,而不会被抬起或被挠起.

blocks.en: BP4D simultaneously records 2D and 3D facial expression videos in the lab. This dataset includes 41 participants (23 females and 18 males) with age ranging from 18 to 29 years. The released videos document the facial expression changes of the participants during eight different tasks. There are about 146,000 frames with 12 AU labels in the provided 2D videos. In our experiment, we split these frames into the training and test parts without overlapped subjects. In each video of training set, we selected one sample from every ten frames and also collected the samples which had different AU labels compared to the previous frame. Ultimately, there are 16627 frames of 28 subjects for training and 45805 frames of 13 subjects for testing. When evaluating the visual presentation in Tab.3 in the main text, we used the full training set.
blocks.zh: BP4D同时记录了实验室中的2D和3D面部表情视频. 该数据集包括41名参与者(23名女性和18名男性),年龄介于18至29岁之间. 发布的视频记录了参与者在8个不同任务中的面部表情变化. 在提供的2D视频中,大约有146,000个帧并有12个AU标签. 在我们的实验中,我们把这些相框分成训练和测试部分,而不重复的科目. 在每集培训录像中,我们从每十个帧中选择一个样本,并收集了与前一个帧相比具有不同非盟标签的样本。 归根结底,共有16627个框架,28个培训科目,45805个框架,13个测试科目。 在评价正文中Tab.3中的视觉演示时,我们使用了完整的训练集.

blocks.en: DISFA collected spontaneous facial expressions of 27 participants while watching movie clips in the lab, annotating both the five intensity levels and 12 AU labels of each frame image. each video from the participant contains 4845 facial expression images and there are about 130,000 images in DISFA. We split these frames into the training and test parts without overlapped subjects. In each video of training set, we selected one sample from every ten frames and also collected the samples which had different AU labels compared to the previous frame. Ultimately, there are 14814 frames of 24 subjects for training and 14535 frames of 3 subjects for testing.
blocks.zh: DISFA在实验室观看电影片段时收集了27名参与者的自发面部表情,同时标注了每个帧图像的5个强度级和12个AU标签. 来自参与者的每段视频包含4845个面部表情图像,DISFA中约有13万个图像. 我们把这些相框分割成训练和测试部分,没有重复的科目. 在每集培训录像中,我们从每十个帧中选择一个样本,并收集了与前一个帧相比具有不同非盟标签的样本。 归根结底,共有14814个24个培训科目框架和14535个3个测试科目框架。

blocks.en: GFT records facial expression variations in 32 groups of three individuals during social gatherings, including 96 participants. It is the first dataset to capture facial expressions of multiple individuals in natural communication and interactive scenarios. The dataset we prepared comprises approximately 133,000 frames annotated with 10 AUs. In our experiment, we split these frames into the training and test parts without overlapped subjects. In each video, we selected one sample from every ten frames and also collected the samples which had different AU labels compared to the previous frame. Ultimately, there are 17719 frames of 78 subjects for training and 4034 frames of 18 subjects for testing.
blocks.zh: GFT记录了32个群体在社交集会期间的面部表情变化,包括96名参与者. 它是第一个在自然交流和互动情景中捕捉多个人面部表情的数据集. 我们编制的数据集包括大约133 000个附有10个非盟说明的框架。 在我们的实验中,我们把这些相框分成训练和测试部分,而不重复的科目. 在每段录像中,我们从每十个帧中选取一个样本,并收集了与上个帧相比具有不同非盟标签的样本。 归根结底,共有17719个培训科目框架和4034个18个测试科目框架。

blocks.en: EmotioNet contains over 1,000,000 facial expression data downloaded from the internet. It includes manual annotations for 50,000 images, specifying 11 AUs. The manually annotated images are divided into two parts: a validation set (publicly released) and a test set (not publicly released). Additionally, approximately 900,000 facial expression images were annotated using automated methods for AU and emotion labels, but these labels may contain noise. To ensure the accuracy of the data, we used the manual annotated images (approximately 21,000 images) labeled with 11 AUs for our experiment. We randomly split these images into the training and test parts. As a result, there are 19046 images in the training dataset and 2117 images in the test dataset.
blocks.zh: EmotioNet包含超过1,000,000个从互联网上下载的面部表情数据. 它包括对5万个图像的人工说明,指定了11个AU. 手动附加说明的图像被分为两部分:一个验证集(公开发布)和一个测试集(没有公开发布). 此外,大约90万张面部表情图像被用自动方法对AU和情感标签进行注释,但这些标签可能含有噪音. 为了确保数据的准确性,我们使用带有11个非盟标记的手动附加说明的图像(大约21 000个图像)进行实验。 我们随机将这些图像分解为训练和测试部分. 因此,训练数据集有19046个图像,测试数据集有2117个图像.

blocks.en: RAF-AU contains 4,601 facial images annotated with 32 AUs in the wild. Some AU annotations distinguish the AU of upper, lower, left, and right regions of the face, by adding ”T”, ”B”, ”L”, ”R” to the AU numbers, such as ”17+B22+T24”. In our experiment, we did not distinguish this different regions AU and removed the region signs, suggesting that the presence of AU in any region of the face was regarded as the presence of that AU. In addition, we only used the AUs shown in Table S1 in this dataset. We randomly split all images into the training and test parts. As a result, there are 3733 images in the training dataset and 868 images in the test dataset.
blocks.zh: RAF-AU包含有4,601个面部图像,并附有32个AU在野外的注释. 一些非盟说明通过在非盟数字中加上“T”、“B”、“L”、“R”,如“17+B22+T24”,区分了面部上下、左和右区域的非盟。 在我们的试验中,我们没有区分这些不同的区域,并删除了区域标志,表明非盟在任何地区的存在都被视为非盟的存在。 此外,我们只使用本数据集表S1所示的AU. 我们随机将所有图像分入训练部分和测试部分. 因此,培训数据集有3733幅图像,测试数据集有868幅图像.

blocks.en: AffectNet is a multi-class dataset collected from internet, including 287,618 training images annotated with 8 basic emotion classes: neutrality, happiness, sadness, anger, surprise, fear, disgust, contempt. Each AffectNet image only has one of the 8 emotion labels. In our experiment, we used all the official training and test images. The test dataset comprises 4000 images, with each of the 8 basic classes containing 500 images.
blocks.zh: AffectNet是一个从互联网上收集的多级数据集,包括287,618个训练图像,附加了8个基本情感课:中立,幸福,悲伤,愤怒,出人意料,恐惧,厌恶,蔑视. 每个AffectNet图像只有8个情感标签之一. 在我们的实验中,我们使用了所有的正式训练和测试图像. 测试数据集由4000个图像组成,其中8个基本类各有500个图像.

blocks.en: RAF-DB is a multi-class dataset containing of a 7-class basic emotion part and a 12-class compound emotion part. In our experiments, we used all the compound label part, where the labels were formed by combining 2 of the 6 classes: happy, sad, anger, surprise, fear, disgust. We randomly split all the 3954 images into the training and test parts. As a result, there are 3162 images for training and 792 images for testing.
blocks.zh: RAF-DB是一个多级数据集,包含一个7级基本情感部分和一个12级复合情感部分. 在我们的实验中,我们使用了所有的复合标签部分,通过将6个类中的2个类合并而形成标签:快乐,悲伤,愤怒,惊讶,恐惧,厌恶. 我们随机将所有3954图像分入了训练和测试部分. 因此,有3162个图像用于培训,792个图像用于测试.

blocks.en: FaceME is a multi-label facial expression dataset collected from the internet, containing 10,062 images and 85 labels. The labels not only include emotions, but also labels about action, health, and inward thoughts. Each image is labelled by 3 annotators. To enhance the credibility of the labels, we only used the labels that are annotated presence by at least 2 annotators. In our experiment, we used all images for training without dividing test dataset.
blocks.zh: FaceME是一个从互联网上收集的多标签面部表情数据集,包含有10,062个图像和85个标签. 标签不仅包括情感,还包括关于行动,健康和内在思想的标签. 每个图像由3个注释者标出. 为了提高标签的可信度,我们只使用了至少由两个注释员注释存在的标签. 在我们的实验中,我们使用了所有图像进行训练,而没有分割测试数据集.

The second part discusses the comparison with SOTA AU detector (DGCN [ Jia et al.(2023)Jia, Xu, Zhou, Wang, and Li ] ) measured by A c c . % Acc.\% on RAF-AU.

blocks.en:
Tables S2 and S3 report the performance of visual representations, including F1 scores on BP4D and RAF-AU datasets, and classification accuracy on AffectNet dataset. Different from the experiment in Sec. 4.2, these classifiers were trained on the combination of full EmotioNet, RAFAU training sets and sampled BP4D, DISFA and GFT training sets, rather than single datasets. The sampling strategy is introduced in Sec. S2 .
In addition, we selected more AUs in RAF-AU for the experiment.
ViT-B stands for the pre-trained image encoder. The values are reported under a linear probe strategy.
ViT-B fine-tune {}^{\text{fine-tune}} is ViT-B fine-tuned on the training data for AU detection or emotion classification, using a fine-tuning strategy.
Other models with the names formatted as ¡ViT-B/QFormer¿(AU/Emot/Mix/Cat/Exp) denote the visual representations (e.g., the image encoder or Q-Former) from the varied models (i.e., AU-BLIP, Emot-BLIP, Mix-BLIP, Cat-BLIP, Exp-BLIP).
For these representations, linear probe strategies were applied. The language model trained with ViT-B/QFormer is OPT2.7B.
All the models were trained for 20 epochs except for ViT-B fine-tune {}^{\text{fine-tune}} which was trained for 50 epochs. Tables S4 and S5 report the performance of classifiers trained following the same settings above, except for the use of image encoder ViT-G and language model OPT-6.7B.
blocks.zh:
表S2和S3报告了视觉表现的性能,包括BP4D和RAF-AU数据集的F1分数,以及AffectNet数据集的分类精度. 与第4.2节的试验不同,这些分类人员接受了关于全EmotioNet、RAFAU培训组合以及BP4D、DISFA和GFT培训组合样本的培训,而不是单一数据集的培训。 采样策略在S2中介绍。
此外,我们还在RAF-AU选择了更多的非盟进行实验.
ViT-B代表了被预先训练的图像编码器. 数值在线性探测战略下报告。
VIT-B微调QQText{fine-tune}是VIT-B微调,用于非盟检测或情感分类的培训数据,使用微调策略.
其他名称被格式化为'ViT-B/QFormer'(AU/Emot/Mix/Cat/Exp)的模型表示来自各种模型(即AU-BLIP,Emot-BLIP,Mix-BLIP,Cat-BLIP,Exp-BLIP)的视觉表现.
对于这些表述,采用了线性探测战略。 使用ViT-B/QFormer培训的语言模型为OPL2.7B.
除了VIT-B微调QQtext{fine-tune}}被训练为50个时代之外,所有模特都接受了20个时代的培训. 表S4和S5报告了按照上述相同设置培训的分类人员的业绩,但使用图像编码器VIT-G和语言模型PROP-6.7B除外。

blocks.en: Tables S2 and S3 show that all of the ViT-B and Q-Former models with linear probe strategy in our approach outperform the ViT-B baseline. This suggests that incorporating language tasks improves the visual representations and enhances performance on related downstream tasks. It is also observed that the features of Q-Former are superior to those of the corresponding image encoder, suggesting a stronger visual representation of Q-Former than the image encoder. This observation is consistent with the main text and Tables S4 & S5 .
blocks.zh: 表S2和S3显示,在我们的方法中,所有具有线性探测策略的VIT-B和Q-Former模型都超过了VIT-B基线. 这表明纳入语言任务可以改善视觉表现并增强相关下游任务的表现. 也观察到了Q-Former的特征优于相应的图像编码器的特征,表明Q-Former的视觉表现比图像编码器更强. 这一意见与正文和表S4 & S5一致.

blocks.en: Compared with ViT-B baseline with linear probe strategy, ViT-B fine-tune {}^{\text{fine-tune}} with fine-tuning strategy achieves better performance on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks. To explore the advantages of fine-tuning strategy, we fine-tuned each model in Tables S2 and S3 and the results are shown in Tables S6 and S7 . The settings of the models in Tables S6 and S7 are the same as those in Tables S2 and S3 except for the fine-tuning strategy.
blocks.zh: 与有线性探测策略的ViT-B基线相比,有微调策略的ViT-B微调QQtext{fine-tune}在非盟检测和情感分类任务上都取得了更好的性能. 为了探索微调策略的优点,我们对表S2和S3中的每个模型进行了微调,结果如表S6和S7所示. 表S6和S7中的模型设置与表S2和S3中的模型设置相同,但微调策略除外.

blocks.en: It is observed that most of the ViT-B and Q-Former models with fine-tuning strategy in our approach perform better than the ViT-B fine-tune {}^{\text{fine-tune}} baseline, further indicating the superiority of our approach in visual representation. Comparing the linear probe results in Tab. S2 and S3 with the corresponding fine-tuning results in Tab. S6 and S7 , all the fine-tuning results show an improvement over the linear probe results, indicating that fine-tuning is a more effective strategy for extracting excellent features when the diversity of training data is large.
blocks.zh: 人们注意到,在我们的方法中,大多数具有微调策略的Vit-B和Q-Former模型的表现优于Vit-B微调的QQtext{fine-tune}基线,进一步表明了我们在视觉表现上的方法的优越性. 比较Tab中的线性探测结果. 在Tab.S6和S7中具有相应微调结果的S2和S3,所有微调结果都显示比线性探测结果有所改进,表明微调是在培训数据多样性较大时提取出优秀特征的更有效策略.

blocks.en: Table S8 reports the classification accuracy on RAF-AU dataset, including the comparison with the SOTA AU detector (DGCN [ Jia et al.(2023)Jia, Xu, Zhou, Wang, and Li ] ). It is observed that the performance of QFormer(AU) is compatible with that of DGCN. However, classification accuracy is not a prevalent metric for AU detection evaluation, because of the unbalanced presence of each AU. Consequently, we add the Average F1 score of each method to Table S8 . The observation of performance evaluated by F1 score is consistent with those in the main text.
blocks.zh: 表S8报告了RAF-AU数据集的分类准确性,包括与SOTA AU探测器(DGCN)的比较[Jia等(2023)Jia, 许, 周. 王,和李] (中文(简体) ). 据观察,QFormer(AU)的性能与DGCN相容. 然而,分类准确性并不是非盟检测评价的普遍衡量标准,因为每个非盟的存在不平衡。 因此,我们将每种方法的平均分F1加到表S8。 由F1分数评价的表现观察与正文一致.

blocks.en: S4 Examples
blocks.zh: S4 实例

blocks.en:
Due to the length constraints of the main text, we are unable to provide examples of Mix-BLIP, Cat-BLIP and Exp-BLIP in the main text. In order to intuitively present the difference of the outputs of Mix-BLIP, Cat-BLIP and Exp-BLIP, We show several examples of the three models’ outputs in Figure S1 .
It can be observed that Mix-BLIP describes only one respect of AU and emotion randomly.
Cat-BLIP describes both AU and emotion while no connection between them.
Exp-BLIP describes not only both facial actions and emotions, but also the inferential relation between them.
blocks.zh:
由于正文的长度限制,我们无法提供正文中Mix-BLIP,Cat-BLIP和Exp-BLIP的例子. 为了直观地呈现Mix-BLIP,Cat-BLIP和Exp-BLIP的输出差异,我们在图S1中展示了三个模型输出的几个例子.
可以看到,Mix-BLIP只描述了一种对非盟的尊重和随机的情感.
Cat-BLIP既描述了非盟,也描述了情感,而两者之间却没有任何联系.
Exp-BLIP不仅描述了面部动作和情感,还描述了它们之间的推论关系.

blocks.en:
Although our models demonstrate promising potential in describing facial expressions, they occasionally produce inaccurate results. Figure S2 illustrates three kinds of bad cases of our models and the bad sentences are underlined.
The first case is caused by large area of facial occlusion. This occlusion restricts the ability of image encoder to extract detail facial information, resulting a wrong description for facial expressions.
The second case is the wrong inference. Our Emot-BLIP and Exp-BLIP infer different emotions from the ground truth, which may be due to the limited capabilities of QFormer and the language model (OPT). Although labeled as contempt, this picture also slightly shows happiness as we predict.
The third case is generating duplicate outputs. The outputs of our models inherit the drawbacks of language model. OPT model sometimes tends to generate repeated and syntax error sentences, which will appear in the outputs of our models.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的模型在描述面部表情方面展现出充满希望的潜力,但偶尔它们会产生不准确的结果. 图S2显示了我们模型的三种坏案例,并下划线表示坏句子。
第一起病例由面部被大量隔离所引起. 这种隔离限制了图像编码器提取细节面部信息的能力,导致面部表情描述错误.
第二个案例是错误的推断。 我们的Emot-BLIP和Ex-BLIP推断出与地上真理不同的情感,这可能是由QFormer和语言模型(OPT)的能力有限而来. 虽然这张照片被贴上蔑视的标签,但是也略微显示了我们所预测的幸福.
第三个案例产生重复的产出。 我们模式的产出继承了语言模式的缺点。 OPP模型有时往往会产生重复和语法错误句子,这些句子会出现在我们模型的输出中.
